name: Estremera (Spain)
description: Red field within a broad white border, charged with a white crenellated wall with two towers.
history: The arms and flag of Estremera were approved officially in 1994, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 13 October 1994; the flag is rectangular of proportions 2:3, a red cloth charged with a crenellated wall with two towers in white, masoned and open in black, and a white bordure of 1/5 of the width of the flag.
